clean_description: The Power of the Dog follows DEA agent Art Keller as he navigates the treacherous landscape of the drug trade, facing off against the Barrera brothers who run a powerful drug empire. The narrative spans locations from New York City to Mexico, delving into the lives of various characters, including a high-class hooker and a merciless hitman, all intertwined in the violent world of drug trafficking. The novel explores themes of corruption, betrayal, and the brutal realities of the war on drugs.
setting: contemporary drug trade in the Americas
